zh-CN.name: 夸张极简主义
zh-CN.description: 工作用风格标签：保留很少的内容，同时用超大标题、醒目比例或强烈留白制造冲击。强调的是视觉主次，不是删除用户完成任务所需的信息。
use_when: 首屏有一个需要突出表达的核心信息。
品牌主题适合以排印作为主要视觉。
avoid_when: 不适合依赖同时比较大量信息的界面。
长标题不能在手机上被截断或挤出按钮。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 用一个大标题承载首屏主题，其余信息精简为必要说明和主操作；通过留白与比例形成张力；为长文案和窄屏降低字号或换行，保持正文可读。

en.name: Exaggerated Minimalism
en.description: A working style label for sparse content with oversized headings, striking proportions or pronounced whitespace. It emphasizes visual priority without removing information required to complete a task.
use_when: The opening screen has one central message to emphasize.
Typography can carry the main brand expression.
avoid_when: It is a poor fit for comparing many data points at once.
Long headings must not be clipped or crowd actions on mobile.
en.prompt_template: Let one oversized heading carry the first-screen message, supported by essential copy and a primary action. Use whitespace and proportion for emphasis. Adapt type size and wrapping for long copy and narrow screens while keeping body text readable.
